title: Fine-tuning & Alignment
blurb: How raw language models become usable assistants, and how tuning them got cheap enough to do on one GPU.

anchors.note: The policy-gradient method the whole RLHF stack was built on. Read it before InstructGPT.
Human feedback beats supervised fine-tuning on summarisation. The proof of concept for RLHF.
RLHF applied at scale to instruction following. This is the recipe behind ChatGPT.
Replaces most human feedback with a written constitution and model self-critique.
Shows the RLHF objective has a closed-form solution — no reward model, no RL loop. Removed most of the machinery.
Tune a small continuous prefix rather than the model. The start of parameter-efficient tuning.
Low-rank updates to frozen weights. The single most widely deployed fine-tuning method.
4-bit base model plus LoRA adapters, so a 65B model fine-tunes on one consumer GPU.
